description: A simple spreadsheet control for Avalonia, with an integrated formula engine and custom function support.
releaseNotes: v1.6.0: Add true column hiding (HiddenColumns, SetColumnVisible, SetColumnsVisible, ShowAllColumns, IsColumnHidden, IsColumnVisible, NextVisibleColumn and the Spreadsheet-level HideColumn / ShowColumn / HideRow / ShowRow convenience methods): a hidden column keeps its index but has a width of zero, so its data, header letter, header caption and grid lines disappear and the neighbouring columns are drawn seamlessly next to each other; hidden columns are skipped by rendering, hit testing, keyboard navigation, copy, paste, clear and fill, and are written as hidden Excel columns (XlsxExportOptions.ExportHiddenColumns, false by default). Fix a potential infinite loop in Table.GetRangeX / Table.GetCell when a column has zero width. Add ButtonCell, a clickable button (or underlined link) cell for values that are chosen from an external dialog instead of being typed (e.g. auxiliary accounting items): clicking it raises the new Spreadsheet.CellTapped / CellDoubleTapped events carrying the column, the row, the ButtonCell itself plus its CellType and Tag; while SuppressEdit is set (the default) double clicking, typing, F2 and Backspace do not open the editing box, and the chosen value is written back through Data which repaints the cell. v1.5.0: Add TreeGradeCell (account-tree cell with dotted guide lines and a +/- toggle box) together with the row-visibility infrastructure it needs (HiddenRows, SetRowVisible, ShowAllRows, IsRowVisible, NextVisibleRow, MoveVisibleRows): collapsed rows keep their index but occupy no vertical space and are skipped by rendering, hit testing, keyboard navigation, copy, paste, clear and fill. Clicking the toggle box raises the new Spreadsheet.TreeExpand event; with AutoManageRows (default true) the control also collapses / expands the rows below according to the node levels, otherwise the host does it through SetRowVisible. Add NumericCell (thousand separators, fixed decimals, zero as empty, optional red strikethrough / negative red) with commit-time validation: invalid input is rejected, the cell keeps its value, nothing is pushed onto the Undo stack and the new Spreadsheet.InvalidInput event is raised; NumericLinkCell now shares the same formatter. Add read-only ranges (SetRangeReadonly / IsCellReadonly / ReadonlyRanges) that block editing, pasting and clearing but still allow selecting and copying. Add the Spreadsheet.CellEditEnded event, raised after the data has been written (or after Escape / a rejected input) so hosts can recalculate dependent cells. Numeric cells are exported as real Excel numbers and collapsed rows are hidden in the exported sheet (XlsxExportOptions.ExportHiddenRows). v1.4.0: Export the spreadsheet to Excel .xlsx through the new SaveXlsx method (XlsxExporter + XlsxExportOptions): TitleCells become editable multi-line rich text runs; LinkCells become plain text (optionally with a real Excel hyperlink via ExportLinkAsHyperlink); formulas are kept when they are Excel-compatible (AVG is translated to AVERAGE) and replaced by their cached value otherwise; column widths, row heights, merged ranges, background fills, borders, fonts and text alignment are preserved. v1.3.0: Add LinkCell and NumericLinkCell, custom clickable hyperlink cells rendered instead of the regular text (three-state colours: link / pressed / visited, optional strikethrough, hit-testing cached during render); NumericLinkCell formats amounts with thousands separators and configurable decimals, renders zero values as empty (or "..." with ResponseEmpty); hovering shows a hand cursor, clicking (mouse press+release or Space while selected) raises the new Spreadsheet.LinkClick event carrying column, row and LinkPara; exposed through Table.LinkCells / RgfData.LinkCells / SpreadsheetControl.LinkCells, supported inside merged ranges. v1.2.0: Add TitleCell, a custom cell type for multi-chunk report captions (e.g. a title line followed by a subtitle line), exposed through Table.TitleCells / RgfData.TitleCells / SpreadsheetControl.TitleCells and rendered inside merged ranges; harden TitleCell font resolution so unresolvable font names or default (uninitialised) Typefaces fall back to the default font instead of throwing a NullReferenceException during layout. v1.1.3: Fix explicit border rendering off-by-one at the right/bottom edge of the viewport; clear cached formula results when loading RGF documents; refine ReoGrid v3 RGF parsing (v-border pos handling, style inheritance, font-size pt to DIP conversion, bold-only styles).
